trigger_phrase_or_event: copy locked in package before prompt/image handoff

copy_lock.copy: some people change the weather inside you.
before them, everything feels too loud.
the same thoughts. the same worries. the same life.
then they sit next to you, and somehow...
your chest stops arguing with the world.

nothing is fixed.
but everything feels softer.

maybe love is just this.
one person making life feel bearable again.

agents.prompt_summary: Extract visual mechanics from references without copying frames, likenesses, or exact labels.
Prove every locked slide through concrete Aachu/Zuv behavior, not decorative illustration.
Define wants, hidden needs, eye-lines, hands, posture, distance, and joke-to-tenderness movement.
Plan readable text and brandmark placement for separate native 3:4 and 9:16 outputs.
Translate the selected visual system into specific final-generation and integrated-text constraints.
Select one system only after scoring copy alignment, relationship proof, visual variety, identity, aspect safety, and sendability.

visual_system_candidates.name: Slide-Led Evidence Plan
visual_system_candidates.case_for: Best preserves the locked copy while proving each beat through visible relationship behavior.
visual_system_candidates.risk: Must stay accountable to per-slide copy and avoid drifting into generic couple art.

visual_system_candidates.name: Format-First Label System
visual_system_candidates.case_for: Keeps the carousel visually legible and taggable when the concept depends on labels or a meme grammar.
visual_system_candidates.risk: Can become gimmicky if labels replace body language.

visual_system_candidates.name: Cinematic Romance Blocking
visual_system_candidates.case_for: Protects eye-lines, hands, distance, and emotional reversal.
visual_system_candidates.risk: Can become too soft or abstract if the hook needs deadpan specificity.

cross_debate: Keep the approved copy locked and make visuals do proof work.
Reject decorative quote-card scenes, generic couple stock poses, and repeated props.
Preserve the selected visual system unless visual-plan-quality records an explicit repair.
why_it_wins: Slide-Led Evidence Plan wins because it keeps the visual system accountable to the selected story arc.

slide_visual_blueprint.copy: some people change the weather inside you.
slide_visual_blueprint.scene: A warm interior scene with one partner arriving emotionally crowded by the day: bag dropped, phone in hand, shoulders tense, the room feeling slightly compressed. The other partner is present nearby but not heroic or therapist-like, simply noticing with gentle attention. The feeling should be weather-like through light and posture, not literal clouds.
slide_visual_blueprint.must_show: Visible Aachu/Zuv relationship behavior that proves the exact copy.

slide_visual_blueprint.copy: before them, everything feels too loud.
slide_visual_blueprint.scene: A closer, slightly crowded frame: notifications glow on the phone, keys or bag are messy, shoulders lifted, eyes tired. The other partner is not solving anything yet; the room and objects make the loudness visible without using literal sound effects.
slide_visual_blueprint.must_show: Visible Aachu/Zuv relationship behavior that proves the exact copy.

slide_visual_blueprint.copy: the same thoughts. the same worries. the same life.
slide_visual_blueprint.scene: A wider room scene where the practical world is still visible: phone, small bills or notebook without readable text, laundry or daily objects, unfinished cup. One partner is mid-thought, the other sits close enough to be present. Nothing is fixed yet.
slide_visual_blueprint.must_show: Visible Aachu/Zuv relationship behavior that proves the exact copy.

slide_visual_blueprint.copy: then they sit next to you, and somehow...
slide_visual_blueprint.scene: The partner simply sits beside them on the bed, sofa, or floor edge. No advice pose, no lecture. Hands are close but not forced; eye-line softens; body distance reduces a little. The scene should prove presence as the action.
slide_visual_blueprint.must_show: Visible Aachu/Zuv relationship behavior that proves the exact copy.

slide_visual_blueprint.copy: your chest stops arguing with the world.
slide_visual_blueprint.scene: A gentle mid-hour beat: the tense partner is now exhaling, maybe leaning back or laughing softly while still holding the phone face down. The other partner's presence makes the body loosen; hands unclench, shoulders drop. Use chest/shoulder posture as the receipt.
slide_visual_blueprint.must_show: Visible Aachu/Zuv relationship behavior that proves the exact copy.

slide_visual_blueprint.copy:
nothing is fixed.
but everything feels softer.
slide_visual_blueprint.scene: The key proof slide: same phone/problem remains in the frame, but the emotional weather has changed. The couple is calmer, closer, maybe sharing a small laugh or quiet side-by-side silence. The outside world is unchanged; light and posture are softer.
slide_visual_blueprint.must_show: Visible Aachu/Zuv relationship behavior that proves the exact copy.

slide_visual_blueprint.copy:
maybe love is just this.
one person making life feel bearable again.
slide_visual_blueprint.scene: A final quiet wide shot after the hour: both people settled close in the same room, ordinary objects still around, but the frame breathes. One small shared gesture, like shoulder against shoulder, fingers touching, or a shared smile, lands the emotional thesis without grand romance.
slide_visual_blueprint.must_show: Visible Aachu/Zuv relationship behavior that proves the exact copy.

typography_and_aspect_plan.instagram_post_3x4: Keep copy in generous warm-paper negative space near the relevant person or focal action; protect faces and hands.
typography_and_aspect_plan.reels_stories_9x16: Recompose natively with taller breathing room; do not crop, resize, pad, or extend the 3:4 artwork.
typography_and_aspect_plan.brandmark: Tiny low-contrast handwritten @a.storyof.two at top-right inside artwork.
